title: A Pup on a Sun Hat
lines: A sun hat is on a rug.
A tan pup hops up and naps on the hat.
"A pup is on the hat!" said Liz.
"Do not tap the pup," said Zeb.
Zeb gets a pan and taps on it.
The pup hops up and runs to a tub.
Liz gets the hat. A mud dot is on top.
Liz rubs at the mud dot.
"The pup can have the rug," said Zeb.
scoring_note: This passage says "do not". Decodability forbids apostrophes. A child who reads "don't" is reading for meaning — do not score it an error.
limit_note: This lesson is named for z /z/, and the only z on this page is in the names Liz and Zeb. A name is not evidence a child decoded a sound, so the score here measures short-vowel decoding, NOT /z/. Read it that way.
